recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for current FHIR core. No core source follow-up is needed unless the work group reintroduces ImmunizationRecommendation or another current artifact that intentionally republishes the immunization recommendation date criterion value set.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PHER issue for STU3 asking that the ImmunizationRecommendation date criterion example value set use the LOINC codes used in the v2.8.2 immunization guide instead of local example codes such as earliest, recommended, and overdue.
initial_application: Commit 4f695a9d5532dffe92ace7f2bb69cc728fbd1702 applied the Jira request on 2017-09-25 by deleting the local date criterion code system and changing source/immunizationrecommendation/valueset-immunization-recommendation-date-criterion.xml to compose from http://loinc.org with codes 30981-5, 30980-7, 59777-3, and 59778-1.
additional_context: Commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 later removed ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation from current core, including deletion of the date criterion value set source. Current source/fhir.ini lists Immunization as active but has no active ImmunizationRecommendation resource entry, and current source searches find the old value-set canonical only in source/oids.ini. Jira searches found only FHIR-13483 and one broad unrelated ValueSet metadata issue; Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflict.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No source files were changed because the requested source change was already applied historically and the current FHIR core checkout no longer has an active ImmunizationRecommendation or immunization-recommendation-date-criterion value-set source to edit.
